claim_boundary: Capabilities marked direct resolve to implemented code, committed machine evidence, and bounded public-data scenarios. Transferable and boundary-only entries describe a method or inference limit that can inform another domain; they are not evidence of domain deployment, client work, model accuracy, policy effect, health impact, spatial analysis, adoption, or external validation.

capabilities.title: Point-in-time data and revision control
capabilities.summary: Separate economic time from knowledge time, preserve every published vintage, and fail closed when an exact historical availability claim cannot be supported.
questions: What exact value was defensibly knowable at the decision boundary?
Which later revisions must remain evaluation-only?
does_not_prove: Source authenticity beyond the identified public artifact
That a current API response was available at an earlier date

capabilities.title: Statistical validation and falsification
capabilities.summary: Retain negative attempts, enforce holdout and embargo boundaries, adjust for a declared hypothesis family, and keep post-event misses visible instead of rewriting the range.
questions: Which attempt family was declared before evaluation?
What evidence would reject or revise the claim?
does_not_prove: General forecast skill
External statistical or domain-method validation

capabilities.title: Decision-making under risk and constraints
capabilities.summary: Connect uncertainty intervals, downside scenarios, non-zero costs, capacity, infeasibility, reversal thresholds, and value of information before an allocation can become eligible for a later gate.
questions: Which action remains feasible under capacity and downside constraints?
Where does the preferred decision reverse?
does_not_prove: An executable trade or fiduciary recommendation
Realized return, capacity, or market impact

capabilities.title: Model governance and stop decisions
capabilities.summary: Make reject, revise, infeasible, and do-not-claim outcomes first-class results so a polished output cannot silently overrule failed evidence gates.
questions: When must the system reject or narrow a claim?
Which human review boundary remains after the automated checks pass?
does_not_prove: Training or deployment of a production AI model
A certified governance process or organizational adoption

capabilities.title: Information systems and reproducible delivery
capabilities.summary: Join typed source contracts, temporal eligibility, deterministic builders, portable reports, hashes, CLI workflows, and a public read-only explorer into one inspectable delivery chain.
questions: Can another person rebuild the same artifact from the declared inputs?
Which source or schema boundary should fail closed?
does_not_prove: Production readiness or an availability SLA
Institutional adoption or user impact

capabilities.title: Financial-system and regulatory reasoning
capabilities.summary: Combine filings, central-bank releases, rates, auctions, positions, liquidity, and bounded accounting relationships without converting them into causal failure stories or investment performance.
questions: Which financial fact was reported, inferred, or simulated?
How do market, accounting, and regulatory constraints alter the decision?
does_not_prove: Causal attribution of a financial event
Live trading, client work, or investment performance

capabilities.title: Public-policy evidence and implementation boundaries
capabilities.summary: Use official labor, price, trade, production, credit, and fiscal releases to practice decision-time evidence discipline while keeping descriptive indicators separate from policy effects and implementation claims.
questions: What can the official indicator support at the decision time?
Which stakeholder, distributional, implementation, or causal evidence is still missing?
does_not_prove: A causal policy effect or welfare improvement
Public-sector client work, implementation, or service impact

capabilities.title: Behavioral and causal inference boundaries
capabilities.summary: Show why aggregate saving, retail, or credit changes do not identify individual motives, treatment effects, welfare, or the likely result of an intervention.
questions: Which behavioral mechanism is unobserved?
What experimental or quasi-experimental evidence would be needed before recommending an intervention?
does_not_prove: A measured behavioral mechanism
A designed or validated intervention

capabilities.title: Population and place evidence boundaries
capabilities.summary: Use housing, construction, prices, and labor aggregates to expose the information lost when national releases are treated as local, spatial, population, or individual evidence.
questions: What population, geography, denominator, or access measure is absent?
Which local data and stakeholder evidence would be required before acting?
does_not_prove: Health, clinical, patient, GIS, or neighborhood-level analysis
A place-based intervention, site choice, or population outcome

capabilities.title: Reproducible analytical communication
capabilities.summary: Render the same typed claim graph for people and machines, keep limitations beside results, and provide hashes and one-command reproduction rather than a presentation-only conclusion.
questions: Can a reviewer follow every public claim to a machine locator?
Do the human and machine reports preserve the same evidence labels and limitations?
does_not_prove: That the underlying method is externally correct
That documentation quality produced adoption or impact
